title: Many-shot conditioning
description: Add repeated fabricated examples to a candidate as a separate context-conditioning experiment. Keep the underlying mechanism and delivery surface identified.
when_to_try: A controlled comparison can afford a larger payload and context.
prerequisites: Sufficient message, context, token and trial budgets.
limitations: Published harmful-text-generation results do not prove unauthorized tool actions.
The current chat message limit is 6000 characters; context and output limits still apply.
No renderer or many-shot benchmark is implemented by this record.

sources.note: Original research on long-context jailbreak conditioning; transfer to this action-taking target is unmeasured.
